summary: The LiveKit Startup Program provides up to $23K: one year of Cloud Scale free ($6K value, $500/mo waived), $10K in additional LiveKit Cloud credits, and $7K in inference credits ($1K with each participating partner — AssemblyAI, Deepgram, Fish Audio, Gemma, Gradium, Inworld, Rime). Credits expire 12 months from issuance. Eligibility: voice/video/physical AI core to the product, <50 employees, <$5M raised and pre-Series A ($5M+ case-by-case), live website with identifiable founding team, in production or launching within 6 months. A card on file is required to enroll.
claim_steps: Apply via the form at https://livekit.com/startups (no pitch deck required).
On approval you receive a promo code by email; enter it at checkout when starting your Cloud Scale plan.
A card on file is required to enroll. Credits expire 12 months from issuance.
YC-backed companies should apply at livekit.com/yc instead — offers cannot be combined.
